reason: We have to replace lost volume and my two or three salespeople only farm existing accounts, so I need new meetings. The free 15-company list costs me one call, and with 3 free meetings and a EUR 900 cap, one new freight lane pays for the whole pilot many times over.
objection: Do they really understand freight and 3PL buyers, or will I get meetings with junior people who just want a rate quote to compare? And '45 meetings in 2 months' is one client with no name, I want to see who and how many turned into contracts.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies are generic or wrong for our lanes and services, I walk away and do not start the pilot.
